messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "relieves muscle spasm whether or not sedation occurs"
set: ["relieves muscle spasm whether or not sedation occurs", "do not inject into muscle or vein", "call doctor if diarrhea occurs", "decide with healthcare provider whether to take medicine or breastfeed", "avoid sexual activity if priapism occurs", "given in muscle", "consult doctor or pharmacist if unsure whether medication is an MAOI", "talk to your doctor if this occurs", "tell healthcare team if planning surgery or other procedure that uses anesthesia or deep sedation", "dosing schedule occurs after dose has been settled", "maximal effect occurs in 3 to 6 weeks", "inform healthcare provider about unexplained muscle aches or weakness", "tell healthcare provider about muscle cramps, unusual weakness or tiredness, or irregular heartbeat", "do not refrigerate or freeze", "check whether any other product you take already contains acetaminophen", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will breastfeed"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
